_comment: Utopian Landscaping and Paving Solutions, Canberra. Built 2026-09-22, revised 2026-09-23, from www.utopianlandscaping.com.au. Every specific fact on the page is quoted in _source.claimSources with the page it came from, or comes from data/google_reviews_top25.json. Nothing is inferred. tagline: Landscaping and paving across Canberra, Queanbeyan and Yass. Every part of the job done by the one business.

brand._comment: Their logo's red samples at #D80000-#E00000, which only clears 3.7:1 on a dark page. The site accent is #F0483A (~4.9:1), so the wordmark is set in that lifted red, not their original red — it has been recoloured to match the site. The second colour is a sandstone gold taken off the stone in their own photos: a design choice, not a brand asset. Ask Derek for the brand red from his vector.

logo._comment: NOT their artwork. The only logo published anywhere is logo2-280x120.png: 280x120, JPEG-artefacted, with a grey halo and a white plate baked into the pixels and black drop-shadow squares behind the red confetti. Knocking it out left white specks and a grey fringe at the 32px the header renders it at, and the 'LANDSCAPING & PAVING SOLUTIONS' subline was illegible mush at that size, so nothing of theirs is used here. This is their name set in the page's own display face (Big Shoulders 700, lowercase) in the site accent red. Re-rendered 2026-09-23: the previous file was cropped at the baseline, so the 'p' lost its descender and the word read 'utobian'. The canvas is now the measured glyph box (canvas measureText at 300px: ascent 244, descent 61; pixel ink box 752x300) plus a 16px margin on every side, 784x332. It is a stand-in. Get the original vector from Derek and replace it before this goes live.

copy.title: Utopian Landscaping and Paving Solutions — Landscaping & Paving, Canberra
copy.description: Landscaping and paving in Canberra, Queanbeyan and Yass. Retaining walls, paving, decks, turf, irrigation and rockeries, all done by the one business. 5.0 from 25 Google reviews.
copy.headline:
Rough ideas
turned into
real gardens.
copy.sub: You do not need a plan drawn up. Tell Derek what you want the space to do, and his team works out how to build it — then builds all of it. Paving, walls, decks, turf, irrigation and planting.
copy.heroSecondarySms: Or text a photo of the space
copy.statementBody: Most yards get carved up between a paver, a chippy, a fencer and a turf bloke, and you end up in the middle chasing all four. We complete every part of it ourselves, so you only deal with one business — and there is one number to ring when you have a question.
copy.servicesIntro: Retaining and feature walls in stone, brick, sleeper or corten steel. Paving, pool coping, garden edging and concreting. Decks, pergolas, fencing and privacy screens. Rockeries, garden beds, turf, synthetic grass, irrigation, lighting, water features and ponds. School playgrounds and sensory gardens too.
copy.apertureLine: Bring the idea. We will work out how to build it.
copy.workIntro: Six jobs, six different properties. Stone, paving, turf, rockeries, water and a stepped stone terrace — every one of them built by us, start to finish.
copy.processIntro: From the first conversation to the last plant in the ground, you are dealing with the one business the whole way.
copy.recognitionHeadline: Three things a review page will not tell you.
copy.reviewsIntro: From our Google profile: twenty-five reviews, 5.0 average. Three of the six below are marked shortened, because Google cuts them off part way.
copy.areasIntro: And the ACT surrounding areas. It is not a hard boundary either — if you are a bit further out than that, ring anyway and ask.
copy.enquireHeadline:
What do you want
to use it for?
copy.enquireIntro: Talking that through is the part of the job we count as most important. Tell us what the space needs to do and roughly what you picture. Photos of it as it stands help.

process.detail: It starts with what you want to use the area for. We count talking with clients as the most important part of the job, and we keep liaising with you all the way to completion. Bring a plan if you have one, or just tell us what is wrong with the space now.
If you have a design, we build to it. If you only have half an idea, we bring ideas of our own — Patrick Foley's review credits Aaron with “turning my rough ideas into a practical reality”.
Changed your mind? So did John and Val, whose 2007 letter thanks us for requoting however many times they changed the design: “nothing was too much trouble”.
Walls, paving, decking, turf, irrigation, planting, lighting — we complete every part of the project ourselves, so you only ever liaise with the one business.

reviews.name: Kelli Hughes
reviews.text: Derek and his team were a pleasure to have on site. Reliable, energetic and they did a great job of ripping out my front garden and re-landscaping it. They were courteous and trustworthy and came up with good ideas for improving the space. It’s going to look great in a year or two when the new plantings develop

reviews.name: Charlie Stephenson
reviews.text: Derek and the team were fantastic! Great communication throughout the job and the finished work was just what we were after. Derek was able to integrate our native garden into the new landscaping project which included rockeries, paving, turf, irrigation and other features. Utopian is highly recommended.

reviews.name: Patrick Foley
reviews.text: Aaron was really helpful, turning my rough ideas into a practical reality. He was very committed, working through awful weather to get my landscaping done on time and on budget. Im very happy with the finished product, well done Aaron.

reviews.name: Bradley Wood
reviews.text: Derek and his team did a great job with our landscaping. They were very reasonably priced, and were receptive to our ideas as well as communicating well to us on ideas of their own.

reviews.name: Michael Forsythe
reviews.text: They came and did a small paving job for me, converting a soggy dying townhouse lawn into crisp tightly-paved space.

reviews.name: Kathleen Cross
reviews.text: Derek and his team did a wonderful job transforming our once drab backyard into a beautiful oasis we now love spending time in with family and friends.

faq.q: Do I need a design before I ring?
faq.a: No. If you have plans drawn up, we build to them — that is exactly what we do. If all you have is a rough idea and a yard you are sick of looking at, that is enough to start with. Bradley Wood's review puts it plainly: “receptive to our ideas as well as communicating well to us on ideas of their own”.

faq.q: Do you take small jobs, or only big ones?
faq.a: Both. Anything from a small courtyard to a rural property. One of the reviews on this page is a townhouse lawn that was soggy and dying and is now tightly paved; another is a native garden worked into a new landscape with rockeries, paving, turf and irrigation.

faq.q: Do you do the whole job, or subcontract parts of it out?
faq.a: The whole job. Walls, paving, decking, fencing, screens, turf, irrigation, lighting, concreting and planting are all done by us, so you only have to deal with the one business.

Yes. School playgrounds and sensory gardens are on our list. We built a school sensory garden and playground with a sandpit, roly-poly slopes, stepping stones and artificial turf, and the children wrote the thank-you notes for that one themselves, Year 2 right through to Year 6.
Canberra, Queanbeyan, Yass and the ACT surrounding areas. It is not a hard boundary, so if you are a bit further out than that, ring and ask.
